latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Agent Browser, a fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback.
- Enables AI agents to navigate, click, type, and snapshot web pages using structured commands.
- Supports interactive page navigation, form filling, UI testing, page scraping, and automation tasks.
- Offers comprehensive CLI commands for navigation, interaction, element state checking, screenshots, video recording, network control, cookies/storage, tabs, windows, frames, dialogs, JavaScript evaluation, and session state management.
- Provides semantic locators and element refs for user-friendly automation scripting.
